tag: 咖啡店吧台上的咖啡機與糕點展示櫃

level.why: 畫面無人且陳列細節豐富（杯子、咖啡機、磨豆機、層架上的罐子與盤子、展示櫃、飲料桶），可寫出被動式、完成式與細微位置差異。

image_prompt: A realistic photograph of a cafe counter with cups, a coffee machine and a pastry display. Natural lighting, 4:3 landscape orientation, sharp focus, clean and simple composition, in the style of a TOEIC Part 1 photo. Composition: No people. Many distinct objects with clear spatial relationships and states (displayed, stacked, placed, arranged), rich in visible details. No text, signs, logos or brand names anywhere; no readable screens or papers; no celebrities; at most 4 people, with natural proportions, normal hands and fingers, and simple, clearly visible hand actions.
visible_facts: A glass display case on a wooden stand holds croissants and muffins on small white plates.
Rows of coffee cups are arranged on top of an espresso machine.
A coffee grinder stands beside the espresso machine near the window.
Jars, cups and stacks of plates and bowls are on the wall shelf, with more plates stacked on the counter.
A glass drink dispenser, some upside-down glasses and a pile of napkins are at the right end of the counter.

pool.t: Croissants and muffins are being displayed in a glass case.
pool.zh: 可頌與瑪芬被陳列在玻璃展示櫃裡。
pool.why: 正解：展示櫃內的小盤子上放著可頌與瑪芬，與畫面相符。

pool.t: There are several jars lined up along the upper shelf.
pool.zh: 上層架子上沿著架面排著好幾個罐子。
pool.why: 正解：牆上層架的右側排著數個玻璃罐，與畫面相符。

pool.t: A coffee grinder has been placed beside the espresso machine.
pool.zh: 一台咖啡磨豆機被放在義式咖啡機旁邊。
pool.why: 正解：磨豆機位於咖啡機左側、靠近窗邊，與畫面相符。

pool.t: The coffee cups have been placed inside the glass case.
pool.zh: 咖啡杯被放在玻璃展示櫃裡面。
pool.why: 杯子是排在咖啡機上方，玻璃展示櫃裡放的是糕點。

pool.t: Only one jar has been placed on the upper shelf.
pool.zh: 上層架子上只放了一個罐子。
pool.why: 上層架子右側有好幾個罐子，不是只有一個。

pool.t: The water dispenser is located on the left side of the espresso machine.
pool.zh: 飲水桶位於義式咖啡機的左側。
pool.why: 飲水桶在檯面最右端、展示櫃的右後方，咖啡機左側是磨豆機。

pool.t: The white plates are hung on the wall above the shelf.
pool.zh: 白色盤子被掛在架子上方的牆上。
pool.why: hung 與 stacked 是近義干擾；盤子是疊放在架子與檯面上，沒有掛在牆上。

pool.t: A cash register has been placed next to the pastry case.
pool.zh: 一台收銀機被放在糕點展示櫃旁邊。
pool.why: 展示櫃旁沒有收銀機，畫面中也看不到任何收銀機。

pool.t: A refrigerator is standing against the wall near the window.
pool.zh: 一台冰箱靠著窗邊附近的牆站著。
pool.why: 畫面中沒有冰箱，窗邊只有磨豆機與咖啡機。

pool.t: A row of bar stools has been set along the counter.
pool.zh: 一排吧台椅被擺放在吧台前沿著檯面排列。
pool.why: 畫面中沒有任何吧台椅。

pool.t: The cafe is about to open for its first customers.
pool.zh: 這間咖啡店即將為第一批客人開門營業。
pool.why: 畫面沒有人，也看不出營業時間或是否即將開門，這是過度推論。

pool.t: The pastries have been baked fresh early this morning.
pool.zh: 這些糕點是今天一早剛烤好的。
pool.why: 無法從畫面確認糕點何時烘焙，這是過度推論。

vocab.col: glass jar / jar of coffee beans

issues: 圖片內容與 image_prompt 相符：咖啡店吧台、咖啡機、杯子、糕點展示櫃；全圖無人，無可讀文字或商標。
牆上掛著兩幅裱框畫，內容為抽象圖像，未見可讀文字。
右側玻璃飲料桶內是否為水無法完全確認，句子中的 water dispenser 僅作為錯誤句的位置干擾，未作為正解。
盤子、杯子數量多且堆疊密集，文本已避免使用確切數字作為正解。
